resolution.note: validUnit and unattributedSuiteFailure in evals/d23/grade.ts; tests in test/evals/d23-grade.test.ts. v2 run1 unaffected (0/64 correct runs with an unexplained red suite; 0 empty-hidden units in v2/units.txt).

title: The D23 grader fails closed when a unit has no hidden test or the suite fails without naming a file
body:
Why: logic audit 2026-11-13: evals/d23/grade.ts passes when it has nothing to check. classify() keeps validOnMerge true for an empty FAIL_TO_PASS set (10 of 174 classified units, none in v2/units.txt only because the screen dropped them), and gradeArm ignores the full-suite exit code, so a patch that breaks suite loading with no TAP location line has no regression. Checked on v2 run1: 0 of 64 correct runs had an unexplained red npm test, so no published number changes.
Outcome: a unit with no FAIL_TO_PASS test is invalid; a red full suite that names no failing file counts as a regression when the parent suite is green.
Proof: unit tests of validUnit and unattributedSuiteFailure in test/evals/d23-grade.test.ts.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/.
